Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: log

.. py:class:: LoadingBar(n_iters, length=50)

   Class to create a loading bar in the console.
   :param n_iters: number of iterations
   :param length: length of the loading bar


   .. py:attribute:: iter
      :value: 0



   .. py:attribute:: n_iters


   .. py:attribute:: length
      :value: 50



   .. py:method:: update()

      Update the loading bar.



   .. py:method:: end()

      End the loading bar.



.. py:function:: timed(fun)

   Decorator to measure the time it takes for a function to execute.
   :param fun: function to be measured
   :return: wrapper function
